title.rendered: How to download your Snapchat data (Step-by-step guide)

content.rendered:
Key takeaways
  • Downloading your Snapchat data allows you to retrieve login history, chat metadata, saved memories, and other crucial account details.
  • You can download your Snapchat data via the Snapchat app or the Snapchat website; just keep your login details at hand.
  • Once Snapchat has finished processing your data, it will send you the download link to the associated email address.

Have you ever accidentally or out of rage deleted an important Snapchat conversation, and now you regret it? We all have been there. While you may think the chat is gone forever, downloading your Snapchat data can be a lifesaver. Not only will this get you a copy of your deleted conversation, but doing so will also provide you with a complete record of your account.

With the basics out, here’s what information Snapchat stores about you and how you can download it.

What’s Included in Your Snapchat Data?

When you request a download of your Snapchat data, you receive a ZIP file containing various details about your account, including:

  • Login history and account details
  • Snap history (metadata, not actual Snaps)
  • Chat history (metadata, not actual messages)
  • Friends list
  • Memories and saved snaps (if backed up)
  • Search history
  • Bitmoji information
  • Devices used to log in

How to download your Snapchat data on iPhone

  1. Open the Snapchat app and tap your Bitmoji icon at the top left.
  2. Here, tap the Settings cog at the top right corner.
  3. Now, locate and select My Data under Privacy Controls.

  4. Next, log in to your Snapchat account.
  5. Toggle on Export your Snapchat Memories, Chat Media and Shared Stories.
  6. Now, enable Export HTML Files or Export JSON Files. You can also request to download your data from Snapchat in both formats.
  7. Hit Next.
  8. Set a time frame, and tap Submit.

Now, wait for a while as Snapchat processes the files. You’ll get an email when Snapchat is done processing your data. It may take a few hours or days. Also, you may get a verification email from Snapchat. Follow the instructions mentioned in the email.

How to download your Snapchat data on Mac

  1. Using the preferred browser, visit Snapchat.com and log in to your Snapchat account.
  2. Here, click on My Data under the profile menu.

  3. Toggle on Export your Memories, Chat Media and Shared Stories.
  4. Pick either Export HTML Files or Export JSON Files.

  5. Click Next.

  6. Pick a range of dates, then click Submit.

Wait for the email with the download link to export Snapchat data history. Then, let’s learn how to access the recovered Snapchat data.

How to download and extract your Snapchat data

Downloading the Data File:

  1. Open the email to access the link to the Snapchat data file.
  2. Press click here.
  3. Log in to your Snapchat account.
  4. Click See exports → Choose Download.

Accessing the downloaded Snapchat data

On iPhone:

  1. Open the Files app → Go to Downloads.
  2. Tap the ZIP file named Snapchat data to extract it.
  3. Go through files and folders to access your Snapchat information, like messages, stories, and settings.

On Mac:

  1. Launch the Finder app → Head to Downloads.
  2. Double-click the ZIP file named Snapchat Data to unzip it.
  3. Open the extracted Snapchat data folder.

Save your Snap data!

I hope that the information here was helpful enough for you to download and access your Snapchat data. After reviewing the Snapchat data report, we’ve learned that Snapchat collects almost every interaction.

Let us know what you guys think in the comment section below.

FAQs

How long will it take to receive the data download link?

The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

Is the data I download securely stored?

Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it’s important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it’s on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

Can I select specific data to download?

No, Snapchat typically provides all your available data as a unified ZIP file. The only customization option is to include memories and other saved media in your download.

Where is Snapchat data stored?

Your Snapchat data is stored in your local storage as well as on the Snapchat servers.

Does Snapchat data show deleted messages?

Nope, the Snapchat data will only show the messages that are saved in your chats.

  • How to Remix Snaps on Snapchat
  • How to get a Public Profile on Snapchat
  • How to change your Snapchat username

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to receive the data download link?

acceptedAnswer.text: The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

mainEntity.name: Is the data I download securely stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it's important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it's on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

mainEntity.name: Can I select specific data to download?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat typically provides all your available data as a unified ZIP file. The only customization option is to include memories and other saved media in your download.

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Snapchat data is stored in your local storage as well as on the Snapchat servers.

@graph.name: How to download your Snapchat data on iPhone
@graph.description: Recover lost Snapchat chats by downloading your data! Learn how to access chat history, saved memories, and more with this easy step-by-step guide.

step.text: Open the Snapchat app and tap your Bitmoji icon at the top left.
Here, tap the Settings cog at the top right corner.
Now, locate and select My Data under Privacy Controls.
Next, log in to your Snapchat account.
Toggle on Export your Memories, Chat Media and Shared Stories.
Now, enable Export HTML Files or Export JSON Files. You can also request to download your data from Snapchat in both formats.
Hit Next.
Set a time frame, and tap Submit.

title.rendered: How to apply to attend WWDC 2025 in person

content.rendered:
Apple has officially revealed the dates for its Worldwide Developer Conference (WWDC) 2025, which will take place from June 9 to June 13. Like last year, most events will be held online. However, a select group of developers, students, and media professionals will have the opportunity to attend an exclusive in-person event at Apple Park on June 9.

Attending WWDC 2025 in-person offers many advantages, including witnessing major product unveilings live, direct access to Apple experts, networking opportunities, and more. If you’re eager to experience it in person, here’s how to secure your spot.

Who can apply for in-person attendance?

The WWDC 2025 in-person event at Apple Park is invite-only, meaning not everyone can attend. Eligible applicants include:

  • Apple Developer Program & Enterprise Program Members: Individuals or organizations with active memberships.
  • Swift Student Challenge Winners: Students who win Apple’s Swift coding competition.
  • Special Invitees from Apple’s Developer Community: Those who have contributed significantly to Apple’s ecosystem.
  • Selected Members of the Media: Tech journalists, bloggers, and influencers invited by Apple.

Age Requirement: You can apply if you’re between 13 and 17, but a legal guardian must accompany you.

How Apple selects attendees

Due to limited space at Apple Park, Apple randomly selects attendees via a lottery system. However, developers with strong contributions (app development, feedback, community engagement) may have a better chance of being invited.

When and where will WWDC 2025 be held?

Like all previous years, WWDC 2025 will take place at Apple Park, Cupertino, California, from June 9 to 13, 2025. As said, the entire event will take place online. However, a few selected participants will have a chance to attend in person.

The first day of the annual conference will feature the unveiling and release of iOS 19, watchOS 12, iPadOS 19, and macOS 16. As soon as the keynote concludes, the first developer beta of iOS 19 and other operating systems will become available to download. 

We already know which iPhone will support iOS 26, so you can have yours ready to install the beta as soon as it is available to get a hands-on experience.

Is attending WWDC 2025 in-person free?

Yes, Apple does not charge a registration fee. However, travel and lodging are NOT covered, so you must arrange your own expenses. 

How to apply for WWDC 2025 in-person attendance

Since Apple Park has limited capacity, Apple selects attendees via a lottery system. Here’s how you can apply:

  1. Visit the WWDC 2025 Special Event page.
  2. Sign in with your Apple Developer account.
  3. Fill out the application form, ensuring that your developer credentials are up to date.
  4. Submit your application before the deadline: 11:59 p.m. PT on Wednesday, April 2, 2025.

How will you know If you’re elected?

Apple will announce the names of 350 Swift Student Challenge winners on Thursday, March 27, 2025. Among them, 50 Distinguished Winners will receive an invitation to a unique three-day experience, including a special event on June 9. The remaining 300 winners will have the opportunity to attend if they secure a spot in the lottery.

Notably, Distinguished Winners won’t need to participate in the lottery. The remaining 300 winners will have the opportunity to attend if they secure a spot in the lottery.

Once you have completed your registration, Apple will review your application and email you if you are selected as an attendee in the following weeks.

What if I’m not selected for in-person attendance?

Even if you aren’t selected for the in-person attendance, you can enjoy the complete WWDC 2025 virtually. Apple provides a fully immersive online experience worldwide for developers and general viewers. You can:

  • Watch the keynote live: The keynote will be streamed on Apple’s website, YouTube, and the Apple Developer app.
  • Access developer sessions: Attend in-depth technical sessions to learn about Apple’s latest software advancements.
  • Join virtual labs and Q&As: Get direct guidance from Apple engineers through online lab sessions.
  • Engage with the community: Connect with developers through Apple’s Developer Forums and online meetups.

Signing off…

Attending WWDC 2025 in person is a fantastic opportunity for developers and Apple enthusiasts alike as you will get to connect with Apple’s developer community, gain early insights into new technologies, and more. If you meet the eligibility criteria and have a travel budget, don’t hesitate to apply and prepare for an unforgettable experience.

  • Everything We Expect Apple to Announce at WWDC 2025

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to receive the data download link?

acceptedAnswer.text: The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

mainEntity.name: Is the data I download securely stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it's important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it's on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

mainEntity.name: Can I select specific data to download?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat typically provides all your available data as a unified ZIP file. The only customization option is to include memories and other saved media in your download.

mainEntity.name: Where is Snapchat data stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Snapchat data is stored in your local storage as well as on the Snapchat servers.

mainEntity.name: Does Snapchat data show deleted messages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nope, the Snapchat data will only show the messages that are saved in your chats.

title.rendered: How to restore deleted Instagram posts, stories, and reels in minutes

content.rendered:
Losing a cherished Instagram moment—whether it’s a 24-hour story, an older post, or a high-performing reel—can be frustrating, especially if it happens by accident. Fortunately, Instagram has a built-in Recently Deleted feature that allows you to recover your deleted content before it’s permanently removed. However, you must act within a limited timeframe, or the content will be lost forever.

This guide will explain how Instagram’s deletion and recovery system works, step-by-step instructions for restoring your posts, stories, and reels, and solutions if you can’t find your deleted content.

How Instagram’s deletion & recovery system works

The Recently Deleted feature acts as a safety net, similar to the Trash or Recycle Bin on computers. Any deleted Instagram content is temporarily stored in this folder before being permanently erased after a set period.

How long do deleted posts, stories, and reels stay in Recently Deleted?

Important

If you do not restore the content within the timeframe, it will be deleted permanently with no official way to recover it.

Why would you want to restore deleted Instagram content?

There are several reasons why you may want to restore your deleted content:

  • Accidental Deletion: You might have wanted to hide the Instagram post but mistakenly deleted a post or reel.
  • Valuable Content: Posts with important memories, creative projects, or business-related material may need to be restored.
  • Technical Issues: Instagram glitches, crashes, or bugs can accidentally delete your posts.
  • Reposting or Engagement Boost: Brands and influencers may restore older posts to re-engage their audience.
  • Content Strategy Changes: If a post didn’t fit your aesthetic earlier but now does, restoring it is better than reposting.

How to retrieve deleted content on Instagram

If you’ve deleted something by mistake, follow these steps before the time runs out:

Here’s how you can do this: 

  1. Open the Instagram app on your iPhone and head to your Profile. 
  2. Here, tap the Hamburger (more) button at the top right corner. 
  3. Now, tap on Your activity under How you use Instagram section. 
  4. Next, select Recently deleted under the Removed and archived content section.

  5. Choose which content you want to recover: Posts, Stories, or Reels. We have chosen the Posts option to help you understand. 
  6. Now, select the post you want to restore. 

  7. Tap the Three Dot button, then hit the Restore option in the pop-up menu. 
  8. Finally, tap the Restore option on the confirmation prompt that appears.

Note You can directly hit the Restore button to restore the post instead of hitting the Three Dot button and performing extra steps. We took the Three Dot button route because the dedicated Restore button wasn’t working in our case. 

Bonus tip: How to recover old stories on Instagram

Unlike Snapchat, Instagram does not allow stories to stay longer than 24 hours, but they are automatically archived if you have Story Archive enabled.

Here’s how you can do so: 

  1. Head to your Instagram profile and tap the Hamburger button at the top right corner. 
  2. Here, tap on Archive under the How you use Instagram section. 
  3. Select Stories Archive from the dropdown at the top.

  4. Locate and select the story you want to repost.  w
  5. Tap the Share button.

Note Due to licensing restrictions, Instagram does not allow you to reshare archived stories with music if they are older than 24 hours.

Troubleshooting: What if you can’t restore deleted Instagram content?

If you’re unable to recover your deleted posts, stories, or reels, try the following fixes:

  1. Check the Recently Deleted Folder: Ensure your content is still within the 24-hour (stories) or 30-day (posts/reels) limit.
  2. Confirm the Correct Instagram Account: If you manage multiple accounts, make sure you’re checking the right one.
  3. Update the Instagram App: An outdated app may cause issues with the Recently Deleted feature.
  4. Check Your Internet Connection: A poor network connection may prevent content from being restored.
  5. Try Logging Out and Back In: Sign out of Instagram and log back in to refresh your account.
  6. Contact Instagram Support: If your content is still missing, report the issue to Instagram Help Center before it’s permanently lost.

Recover deleted Instagram content… 

Accidents happen, but Instagram’s Recently Deleted feature ensures that losing your beloved stories, posts, or reels shouldn’t be a setback. All you need to do is stay aware of the permanent deletion window, and you’re good to go. Remember, if the content is permanently deleted, there’s no official way to recover it. 

Have more Instagram tips or tricks you would like to share? Drop them in the comments. 

You may also like to read:

  • Instagram notifications not working on iPhone? Here’s how to fix it!
  • How to recover Instagram account on iPhone
  • How to add music to your Instagram stories

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

title.rendered: How to get Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro models

content.rendered:
Until the release of the iPhone 16e, Visual intelligence support was limited to iPhones with a physical Camera Control button, i.e., the original iPhone 16 lineup. However, since the iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max support Apple Intelligence, not having Visual Intelligence support because of a missing button left many users fuming.

Thankfully, Apple shipped the iPhone 16e with an iOS 18 version that supports Visual Intelligence despite lacking Camera Control. And now, with iOS 18.4, Apple has expanded the Visual Intelligence support to iPhone 15 Pro and 15 Pro Max as well. Keep reading to learn how to get Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro in iOS 18.4.

What you can do with Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro?

With Visual Intelligence on your iPhone, you can:

  • Get details about a particular place
  • Ask ChatGPT about what’s in the frame
  • Create calendar events
  • Look up things on Google
  • Summarize and translate text, and more

All processes are done on the device, so there isn’t any risk of data leakage.

How to set up Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro 

Visual Intelligence is among the many new features in iOS 18.4. There are two ways you can set up and use Visual Intelligence on Apple Intelligence-supported iPhones despite the missing Camera Control.

1. Assign Visual Intelligence to Action Button

Introduced with the iPhone 15 Pro, the Action Button replaced the traditional Ring/Silent switch and can be assigned one of many possible functionalities, including activating Visual Intelligence. Here’s how to set up the Action Button to launch Visual Intelligence on your iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16e:

  1. Open Settings and select Action Button.
  2. Depending on where you are on the list, swipe left or right until the Visual Intelligence action appears, and you should have the Action Button set to the Visual Intelligence option.

2. Add Visual Intelligence to Control Center

Besides the Action Button, you can customize the Control Center on your iPhone and add the Visual Intelligence control to it. This is what you need to do:

  1. Swipe down from the top-right corner of the screen to bring up the Control Center.
  2. Here, tap the + button in the top-left corner, then tap Add a Control at the bottom of the screen.
  3. Next, search for Visual Intelligence in the search bar at the top. Alternatively, you can scroll down until the Apple Intelligence section appears.
  4. Tap the Visual Intelligence control to add it to the Control Center.

How to use Visual Intelligence on iPhone 15 Pro

Now that you have successfully set up Visual Intelligence on your iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 16e, you can long-press the Action Button or tap the Visual Intelligence control button in the Control Center to launch and use Visual Intelligence on your iPhone. 

Signing off…

Visual Intelligence is easily one of the best Apple Intelligence features. And it would have been unfair to the iPhone 15 Pro users had Apple kept it limited to iPhones with Camera Control. 

If you like the idea of using Visual Intelligence right now, update your iPhone 15 Pro to iOS 18.4.

Feel free to reach out to us via comments if you need further help.

Explore these:

  • Priority Notifications in iOS 18.4: What it is and how to set it up
  • How to reverse image search on iPhone and iPad

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to receive the data download link?

acceptedAnswer.text: The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

mainEntity.name: Is the data I download securely stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it's important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it's on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

mainEntity.name: Can I select specific data to download?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat typically provides all your available data as a unified ZIP file. The only customization option is to include memories and other saved media in your download.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
Vikhyat has a bachelor’s degree in Electronic and Communication Engineering and over five years of writing experience. His passion for technology and Apple products led him to the tech writing space, where he specializes in writing App features, How-to guides, and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple users. 

 

About Vikhyat Rishi

  • Vikhyat has over five years of experience writing consumer tech content.
  • During his association with Smartprix and Beebom, Vikhyat has tested, tested, and reviewed numerous gadgets, including but not limited to smartphones, TVs, and more.
  • His passion for technology and Apple products led him to iGeeksBlog, where he specializes in writing How-to and troubleshooting guides for fellow Apple enthusiasts.

Experience

Vikhyat embarked on his journey in consumer technology writing in 2019, driven by his passion for technology. He has sharpened his skills through associations with Smartprix and Beebom, where he extensively tested and reviewed various gadgets, focusing mainly on smartphones. Currently, Vikhyat specializes in crafting How-to and troubleshooting guides for the Apple ecosystem at iGeeksBlog. When not typing away on his MacBook Air, he loves exploring the real world.

title.rendered: 20 Best macOS shortcuts for fast workflows

content.rendered:
Siri Shortcuts are a game-changer for automating tasks and streamlining your daily workflow. With macOS Sequoia, Apple has made shortcuts even smarter by integrating AI-powered Siri, making your Mac more intuitive and efficient. In this article, I’ll share 20 of the most useful Siri Shortcuts you can start using to boost your productivity. But first, let’s see how to access them on your Mac!

How to set up Siri Shortcuts on your Mac

Getting started with shortcuts on your Mac is super easy. You can either use ready-made shortcuts from the Shortcuts app or create your own custom ones. You can also download shortcuts shared by others on platforms like Reddit or Routine Hub.

Here I have shared built-in shortcuts in the Shortcuts app. To set them up, open Launchpad and select Shortcuts, or simply search for it using Spotlight (Command + Spacebar). Now, click Gallery on the left panel to find the pre-made shortcuts.

You can now explore different shortcut categories. Click on any shortcut that interests you, then select Add Shortcut. It will now appear in the My Shortcuts section, ready for you to use. Simply, invoke Siri and ask her to run the shortcut.

Note

Alongside every shortcut, I have added a note or an idea for customizing it. It’s fairly simple, but if you face any trouble, check out this complete guide on using the Shortcuts app in macOS for more details.

20 Useful Shortcuts for macOS to boost your productivity

Now, let’s explore some of the best and most useful shortcuts you can start using right away. These will help you automate daily tasks, save time, and boost productivity.

1. Morning Brief: Start your day organized

This shortcut is my daily go-to for staying informed with a quick daily summary. With this shortcut, Siri will tell you the date, current weather forecast, traffic conditions, etc., and play your favorite podcasts. Whether you’re heading out or working from home, this shortcut ensures you get a snapshot of your day without opening multiple apps.

Personalization – You can customize the briefing message and the play order of your chosen podcast. From the editor window, click Show More next to Play Podcast and choose Playback Order.

2. Where’s Next: Get effortless directions

With the Where’s Next shortcut, you’ll always know the details of your upcoming journey. It shows the location of your next calendar event on Apple Maps. You will also see estimated travel time with directions. So, it’s perfect for staying organized and planning your commute efficiently.

Personalized – If you always take public transport or use your bicycle, you can change the default direction’s mode. In the editor window, click Driving and select between walking, transit, or biking.

3. Make PDF: Convert content on the go

I find this shortcut useful because I work with a lot of content. It lets you create PDF versions of web pages, documents, and anything from an app. Simply select the item, click the Share button, select Shortcuts, and choose Make PDF.

Personalization – The editor lets you add media and files as input. Click Images and checkmark the content type.

4. Download File: Save documents from URLs

With this shortcut, you don’t need any extra steps to download files from the web. Simply copy the file’s URL, activate the shortcut, and the file will be saved in your designated folder. It’s great for quickly saving images, videos, or documents without needing to open Safari.

Personalization – You can download photos by selecting Images as the input content type in the editor window.

5. Remove Background from Portrait: Become a pro editor

Do you want to create professional-looking images but don’t know advanced editing? The ‘Remove Background from Portrait’ shortcut instantly eliminates backgrounds from your photos and lets you share them. I use this to make profile pictures or create thumbnails without complex editing tools.

Personalization – In the editor window, you can click Portrait in the “Album is Portrait” section and select Recents. Now, you can remove the background of any image you want.

6. Split Screen: Multitask with split view

I know a split screen on a Mac takes about five seconds. But if you are someone like me, who can’t survive without the side-by-side view, this shortcut is God-sent.

It instantly invokes the split screen of the two chosen apps. Interestingly, macOS Monterey also offers some split-screen presets; search the term in the Gallery section to find them.

Personalization – You can change the selected apps and even the split-screen ratio (click show more) from the editor window.

7. Stop Distractions: Quit & Mute

True to its name, the shortcuts help you stay focused on the work at hand. They turn on Focus mode and quit all other distracting apps except the ones you are working on.

However, the shortcut allows you to keep only one app open. But thanks to my inquisitive nature, I have found a workaround.

Personalization – In the editor window, tap the app name after except and select Ask Each Time. When you run the shortcut, it will bring you a list of apps; check the ones you want to keep open.

8. Batch add reminders: Great for creating lists

Nested reminders are a gem, especially if you want to make a to-do or shopping list. This shortcut further enhances the feature’s ease of use.

The shortcut allows you to add multiple reminders at once. Just copy/paste or enter multiple lines of text; each line will be added as an individual reminder, as shown in the screenshot below.

Personalization – The shortcut does not set an alert; you can make changes from its editor window or Reminder app.

9. Start my next meeting: Must-have for Zoom lovers

The shortcut is designed to help you set up the next virtual meeting. It scans your calendar for an upcoming meeting and auto-connects the call at the right time.

Additionally, it creates a new note in the Notes app with meeting details (mentioned in the event) and turns on DND for the meeting duration.

Personalization – The shortcut does not set an alert. You can make changes from the editor window or the reminder app.

10. Reflect on the day: Best shortcut for journaling

Quite like a good journaling app, the shortcut asks you five questions that cover your mood, today’s achievements, and plans for the next day. And it doesn’t stop at that!

The answers are recorded in the Notes app so that you can review them later. It also turns your next-day goals into reminders to encourage a healthier workflow.

Personalization – It would be wise to edit the note locations so they are separate from your other work, well organized, and secure.

11. Search list: Batch Google search

No matter what you do, a Google search is undoubtedly part of your workflow. And when you have to do multiple searches, this shortcut is a time- and energy-saving wizard.

When you feed a list of search terms to the shortcut, it treats each line as a query and opens several Google tabs in Safari with the individual search results.

Personalization – If you wish to switch the search engine, edit the coding and change Google’s URL to the one you want.

12. Block off: Instant event scheduling

You can quickly create an event in the Calendar app and block an hour off for personal or professional tasks. Just ask Siri to run the shortcuts and pick a date and time.

Since Macs don’t have a built-in timer like the iPhones, this shortcut can be an excellent substitute for that. Apart from my professional engagements, I sometimes set reminders for breaks this way.

Personalization – Depending on your preference, you can change the default one-hour timing and ensure that alerts are active.

13. Reading mode: Awesome shortcut for bookworms

When run, the shortcut turns on DND, enables Dark Mode, plays a chosen playlist, and opens up your preferred reading app. What more could a reader want?

Remarkably, it asks you the minutes you want to devote to reading. Once that is over, it turns off the DND. The only issue is that it does not switch to Light Mode automatically.

Personalization – If you don’t like music in the background or Dark Mode, remove them from the shortcut’s code and add your preferred options.

14. Browse top news: For news buffs

Do you love reading multiple news sources to stay updated? Then you’ll love this one. It fetches RSS feeds from CNN, BBC, NPR, the New York Times, or Techmeme.

When run, the shortcut will ask you to select the news source; then, it will show you the top 10 headlines from the platform. You can select one or more articles to open in Safari tabs.

Personalization – You can increase or decrease the number of headlines you see and change their sorting order.

15. Remind me at home: A blessing for the forgetful ones

Do you often forget important tasks during the long commute from home or office? Don’t worry! The Shortcuts app has you sorted with a location-based reminder.

Add your list of tasks to the shortcut, and it will remind you of them once you reach home. Notably, you can use two variants of the shortcut: Remind me at home and Remind me at work.

Personalization – You can edit the radius and priority of the reminder. This could be a good tweak if you plan to use the shortcut on your iPhone or iPad.

16. Sort lines: Handy for everyone

Although a menial task, sometimes sorting a list of names or things in alphabetical order can be a pain. The Sort Lines shortcut makes it a breeze, saving both time and energy.

Just enter the text you want to sort as input, and as soon as you press Done, it’s done. But I hate that you can’t copy the said text. It kind of defeats the purpose, so I have a workaround.

Personalization – In the editor window, remove the last action and add either Copy to Clipboard or Create Note in its place. Tada! Problem solved.

17. Search GIPHY: For GIF lovers out there

The title says it all! Thanks to this Siri shortcut, you can find a fitting GIF without opening any browser or subsequent website. Plus, share it via email, iMessage, and more within the shortcut itself.

Notably, depending on your internet connection, the shortcut may take some time to load all the GIFs and open the selected one in Preview.

Personalization – Why settle for just one GIF? In the shortcut’s editor window, click Show More and select Multiple to choose and share more than one GIF.

18. Dictate & Share: Convert voice to text

You may be a fast type, but sometimes you feel lazy, or your hand is busy or hurting. Dictation can be a convenient tool at such times, and this shortcut is proof.

It converts your speech in real-time and allows you to share the text via the Mail, Messages, Notes, and Reminder apps. The Shortcuts app also offers another option, Dictate to Clipboard, which copies your words to the Universal Clipboard.

Personalization – By default, the dictation stops when you take a pause, which is quite inconvenient. So go to the editor window, click Show More on Dictate text, and select On Tap.

19. Make new playlist – New weekly playlist

This Siri shortcut is crafted for Apple Music users who love discovering new music and fresh playlists. It will present you with a new playlist every Monday, ensuring the blues are kept at bay.

But if you don’t want to experiment and stick to your favorite tunes, either try Auto Playlist or Top 25 Playlist shortcuts from the Shortcuts Gallery.

Personalization – The shortcuts code does not have much to change, though I recommend you rename the shortcut, as it’s quite a mouthful.

20. What did they say: Amazing shortcut for discovering lyrics

Can’t catch the lyrics of the songs in the background or over YouTube? Instead of asking your friends, colleagues or Google, ask Shazam and quickly get the answer.

However, it will just show you a snippet of the lyrics currently playing, not the whole song. So, it is excellent to confirm certain parts; for the complete lyrics, go to Apple Music or Spotify.

Personalization – After discovering the lyrics, if you want to add the song to a playlist or playing queue, search and select either the Add to Up Next or Playlist action.

Signing off…

Well, these are some of my favorite macOS shortcuts. Remarkably, they are just the tip of the iceberg. Thanks to the built-in gallery, automation support, and third-party gems, there is an excellent time-saving shortcut for everyone and almost every task.

Don’t miss these:

  • How to use automatic window tiling in macOS Sequoia
  • Most useful Terminal commands for macOS
  • How to use Safari Highlights in macOS Sequoia

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

acceptedAnswer.text: The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

mainEntity.name: Is the data I download securely stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it's important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it's on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

title.rendered: How to create and use custom chat lists on WhatsApp

content.rendered:
WhatsApp gives you a bunch of lists at the top of your inbox to filter your chats and quickly jump into a conversation when you need it. For example, there’s Unread to view all your conversations with unread messages and Favorites to access your favorite conversations.

But what if you want to create your own categorization to organize your conversations? Well, thanks to WhatsApp’s custom lists feature, you can create personalized lists to make important conversations in your inbox more easily accessible.

Keep reading to learn how to create and use custom WhatsApp lists on your iPhone.

How to create a custom list on WhatsApp

Before you begin creating a custom WhatsApp list on your iPhone, be sure to update the WhatsApp app to the latest version. Head to the App Store, tap the Apple Account icon in the top-right corner and check to see if WhatsApp has a pending update. If one exists, install it.

Once you update WhatsApp, here’s how you can create a custom chat list:

  1. Open the WhatsApp app, swipe left on the list bar at the top of your inbox, and tap the + icon.
  2. Give a name to your list.
  3. Then, tap Add People or Groups at the bottom and select the conversations (people or group) you want to add to the list.
  4. Tap Done in the top-right corner to save the list.

Alternatively, you can also create a custom WhatsApp chat list from the Settings. This is what that looks like:

  1. In WhatsApp, tap the Settings tab at the bottom.
  2. Select Lists and tap on Create a Custom List on the following page. From here, repeat the same process as mentioned above.

You can also add a Communities chat list by selecting the preset chat list at the bottom.

How to manage custom lists on WhatsApp

After you create a chat list, you can easily manage it: rename it, add/remove conversations, change its order of appearance in the list bar, and more.

Rename a custom list on WhatsApp

You can easily rename your custom chat list on WhatsApp at any time like this:

  1. Tap and hold the list and select Edit from the menu.
  2. Enter a new name in the List Name field and tap Done to confirm the changes.

Add or remove contacts to a custom list

If you no longer want to see conversations with a person in your custom list, you can easily remove them. Similarly, you can add conversations with new people to your custom WhatsApp list.

  1. Long-press on your list and select Edit.
  2. Tap on Add People or Groups if you want to add new people to your list. You will be asked to pick the contacts on the subsequent screen.
  3. If you want to remove a contact, tap the – icon to the left of their name and select Delete.
  4. After making the changes, tap on Done to save the list.

Delete a custom WhatsApp list

At any point in time, if you no longer want the custom chat list you just created, you can delete it. Simply long-press on the list and select Delete from the menu. Confirm the deletion by tapping the Delete button in the confirmation prompt.

Alternatively, go to Settings → Lists, select the custom list you want to delete, and tap Delete List at the bottom.

Change a custom list’s order in the tab bar

By default, the list bar in your inbox shows the Unread list. However, you can choose to reorder the list bar per your preference. Here’s how.

  1. Long-press on your any list in the list bar and select Reorder Lists.
  2. Drag the chat list to your preferred position in the list bar.
  3. Tap Done in the top-right corner to save the changes.

Alternatively, go to Settings → Lists. From here, tap Reorder at the top and rearrange the order of your lists. Hit Done.

Wrapping up

Custom lists are a great way to manage your WhatsApp chats effectively. And the best part is they are customizable, so you can change the name of your custom chat list, add or remove contacts, and delete it whenever required. So go ahead and create custom lists to keep your WhatsApp inbox organized.

FAQs

Will contacts know they are on my custom list?

No, your contacts won’t be notified when you add them to a custom list.

Do custom lists sync across devices?

As of writing this post, custom lists don’t sync with your linked devices.

  • How to schedule WhatsApp messages on iPhone
  • How to delete a WhatsApp group on your iPhone or Android

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to receive the data download link?

acceptedAnswer.text: The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

mainEntity.name: Is the data I download securely stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it's important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it's on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

mainEntity.name: Can I select specific data to download?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat typically provides all your available data as a unified ZIP file. The only customization option is to include memories and other saved media in your download.

mainEntity.name: Where is Snapchat data stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Snapchat data is stored in your local storage as well as on the Snapchat servers.

mainEntity.name: Does Snapchat data show deleted messages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nope, the Snapchat data will only show the messages that are saved in your chats.

title.rendered: How to use App Library on iPhone to find and manage apps

content.rendered:
Key takeaways
  • The App Library automatically categorizes all your apps into folders, making it easy to find and manage them.
  • You can quickly search for any app using the App Library’s search bar, saving time and eliminating the need for endless swiping.
  • Additionally, you have the flexibility to hide apps or choose whether new apps appear on the Home Screen or only in the App Library.

The App Library on iPhone is a useful tool for organizing, finding, and managing your apps. It simplifies decluttering your Home Screen, searching for apps, and hiding private ones. In this guide, I’ll cover everything you need to know—from accessing the App Library to customizing it for a cleaner, more organized iPhone experience. Let’s get started!

What is the App Library on iPhone?

The App Library is a feature introduced in iOS 14 that automatically organizes all your apps into categorized folders, making it easier to access them from a single, organized hub.

Why is it helpful?

  • Automatic organization: Apps are sorted into categories like Social, Entertainment, and Utilities.
  • Quick search: Find any app instantly using the search bar without scrolling through multiple screens.
  • Decluttered Home Screen: Remove apps from the Home Screen while keeping them in the App Library for a clean, minimalist setup.

Now, let’s dive into how it works!

How the App Library organizes apps

The App Library automatically categorizes your apps, making it easier to find what you need without manually creating folders—iOS handles it for you using on-device intelligence.

How apps are organized:

  • Social: Includes messaging and social media apps like WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook.
  • Productivity & Finance: Contains apps like Notes, Calendar, and banking apps.
  • Photos & Videos: Stores photo and video editing apps.
  • Utilities: Includes system apps such as App Store, Calculator, Clock, Safari, and Settings.
  • Suggestions: Displays apps you’re most likely to use based on your habits.
  • Recently Added: Shows newly downloaded apps for quick access.
  • Other: Groups miscellaneous apps like Maps and Health.

Each folder may contain multiple apps, some of which might not be immediately visible. To see all apps inside a folder, tap to expand it or use the search bar for quicker access.

Now, where can you find the App Library? Let’s explore!

How to access the App Library on iPhone

Getting to the App Library is super simple. Here’s how:

  1. Unlock your iPhone and go to the Home Screen.
  2. Swipe left on your Home Screen until the last page of apps, then swipe one more time.
  3. You’ll see the App Library with all your apps neatly organized.
  4. You can open an app by tapping on its full-size app icon. To see all the apps in a category, tap on the small app icons.

How to search and find apps in the App Library

If you have many apps, manually browsing through folders can be time-consuming. Fortunately, the App Library includes a built-in search tool to help you find any app quickly.

Here’s how to search for apps:

  1. Open the App Library.
  2. Swipe down from anywhere and tap on the Search bar at the top.
  3. Start typing the name of the app you want to access and then tap on it when it appears. Else, scroll down the alphabetical list and tap on the app you want. You may also tap on the alphabet (A, B, C, D…) at the right edge of the screen to quickly find the desired app.

Pro tip Even if you’ve removed an app from your Home Screen to create an empty space, you can still search for it in the App Library and open it instantly.

How to change where new apps are downloaded on iPhone

By default, when you download a new app, it appears on your Home Screen. However, you can change this setting so that new apps appear only in the App Library, keeping your Home Screen neat and organized.

  1. Open Settings on your iPhone.
  2. Scroll down and tap Home Screen & App Library.
  3. Under the Newly Downloaded Apps section, select App Library Only.`

Now, you can find new apps in the Recently Added folder in the App Library, preventing clutter on your Home Screen. If you don’t see the app, simply search for it in the App Library.

Move an app from the App Library to the Home Screen

Though I tend to organize my iPhone apps in the App Library, I keep the most used ones on my Home Screen for quicker access. Here’s how to move an app from the App Library back to your Home Screen.

  1. Open the App Library by swiping left on your Home Screen.
  2. Find the app you want to move.
  3. Press and hold the app icon and drag it to the right edge. You will see a new Home Screen page. You may drag it to the right, further to your existing Home Screen, or place the app anywhere you like.

If you want to move apps to App Library, simply tap and hold an empty space on your iPhone Home Screen to enter the edit mode. Now, tap the minus sign on the app icon you want to move. Finally, select Remove from Home Screen.

Tip Is your Home Screen messy and decluttering it manually seems tedious? Learn how to reset your Home Screen layout.

How to remove apps from the App Library

If you wish to remove an app from the App Library, it will be deleted from your iPhone altogether. So, ensure you no longer need the app.

Here’s how:

  1. Find the app you want to delete in the App Library and press and hold its icon.
  2. Tap Delete App and select Delete to confirm your choice.

If you don’t find the app on the folder display, maybe it’s hidden inside the folder. To delete an app from a folder, open the respective folder by tapping on the App Library’s small app icons. Next, long-press anywhere within the folder to enter jiggle mode. Then, tap on the “x” icon to delete an app.

How to use the App Library to hide apps on iPhone

Want to keep certain apps private or reduce Home Screen clutter? Use the hidden folder in the App Library. This Lock and Hide app feature was introduced in iOS 18.

  1. Go to your Home Screen and tap and hold the app you want to hide.
  2. Select Require Face ID from the menu.
  3. Tap Hide and Require Face ID and select Hide App to move the app to the Hidden folder.

It ensures the app content never appears in notifications or Spotlight searches. Don’t worry! The app is still installed and accessible in the App Library. You can always unhide it and add it back to the Home Screen later.

Tip If you don’t want this much hassle, there’s a workaround. You can just hide pages of apps from the Home Screen. First, drag the app to a new Home Screen page. Then, tap and hold an empty space, tap Edit at the top left corner, and select Edit Pages. Now, deselect the page you want to hide, and tap Done.

How to show or hide notification badges in the App Library

If you are a minimalist like me, you may prefer a cleaner look at your App Library. To achieve this, you can hide notification badges in the App Library.

  1. Open Settings and tap Home Screen & App Library.
  2. Under the Notification Badges section, switch the Show in App Library toggle ON or OFF.

    • ON: You’ll see red notification bubbles on app icons.
    • OFF: The App Library will be badge-free for a cleaner appearance.

Signing off…

I hope this guide helped you understand and make the most of the App Library on your iPhone. Whether you prefer a clutter-free Home Screen or enjoy staying organized, the App Library is a game-changer. If you have any questions, feel free to ask in the comments below!

You may also read:

  • App Library not working on iPhone? How to fix it!
  • How to restore deleted apps on iPhone or iPad
  • How to switch between apps on iPhone and iPad

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

mainEntity.name: Can I name my AirPods on a Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, you cannot change the name of your AirPods on a Chromebook. However, you can do so using your Apple device.

mainEntity.name: How long will it take to receive the data download link?

acceptedAnswer.text: The processing time for Snapchat data requests can vary, generally from a few hours to several days. Once your data is ready for download, you will be notified via email.

mainEntity.name: Is the data I download securely stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the data you retrieve through the Snapchat app is securely stored. However, it's important to note that its security cannot be guaranteed once it's on your Mac. To enhance security, it is advisable to protect the downloaded folder with a password.

mainEntity.name: Can I select specific data to download?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, Snapchat typically provides all your available data as a unified ZIP file. The only customization option is to include memories and other saved media in your download.

mainEntity.name: Where is Snapchat data stored?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Snapchat data is stored in your local storage as well as on the Snapchat servers.

mainEntity.name: Does Snapchat data show deleted messages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nope, the Snapchat data will only show the messages that are saved in your chats.

title.rendered: Are AirPods waterproof? Here’s what you need to know

content.rendered:
AirPods are among the most popular wireless earbuds worldwide, offering high-quality sound and great battery life. But that doesn’t mean they’re built for every environment. Before exposing them to wet conditions, it’s important to understand whether your AirPods are waterproof or water-resistant.

Whether you get caught in the rain, work up a sweat while exercising, or accidentally drop your earbuds in the sink, knowing how much moisture your AirPods can handle can help you avoid costly damage. Check out the complete guide below for all the details.

Water resistance ratings of AirPods

The terms “waterproof” and “water-resistant” are often used interchangeably, but they have different meanings:

Waterproof means a device is completely unaffected by water, even when fully submerged, typically up to a certain depth and duration.

However, “water-resistant” means a device can withstand some exposure to water, such as light splashes or sweat. It cannot handle prolonged water exposure and may be damaged by wet conditions.

Most AirPods are water-resistant to some extent but not waterproof. So, they can usually handle a little moisture, such as sweat, but should not be submerged or exposed to flowing water, such as heavy rain.

The table below summarizes the water resistance of all AirPods models.

As for your AirPods case, all AirPods charging cases are not water-resistant except for these four models:

  • MagSafe Charging Case for AirPods (3rd generation)
  • Lightning Charging Case for AirPods (3rd generation)
  • MagSafe Charging Case (Lightning) for AirPods Pro (2nd generation)
  • MagSafe Charging Case (USB-C) for AirPods Pro (2nd generation)

Can you wear AirPods in the shower or pool?

While AirPods are designed for convenience and portability, they are not built for heavy water exposure. Therefore, you should never wear them in the shower or in the pool. Here’s what you need to know about using AirPods in wet conditions:

Light rain and sweat: Some protection, but not waterproof

If you own AirPods (3rd or 4th Gen) or AirPods Pro (1st & 2nd Gen), they come with an IPX4 rating, meaning they can withstand light splashes, sweat, and minor exposure to rain. This makes them suitable for workouts or jogging in drizzly weather. However, IPX4 does not mean they are fully waterproof. Exposure to too much moisture can still cause damage over time.

Shower and swimming: Not recommended for any AirPods model

No AirPods model, including AirPods (1st, 2nd, 3rd, and 4th Gen), AirPods Pro (1 and 2), and AirPods Max, is designed to handle direct water exposure like showers, swimming, or full submersion.

Even models with an IPX4 rating are only resistant to splashes, not continuous water flow or immersion. Steam from a shower can also seep into the internal components, potentially affecting performance.

Water damage and warranty: No coverage from Apple

Apple does not cover water damage under warranty, meaning if your AirPods stop working due to moisture exposure, you’ll have to pay for a replacement. To avoid costly repairs, it’s best to keep your AirPods dry and away from high-moisture environments.

Bottom line: While AirPods can handle small splashes and sweat, they are not waterproof and should never be used in the shower, pool, or any situation where they could be submerged in water.

Tips to protect your AirPods from water damage

To keep your AirPods safe and functioning properly for a long time, follow these essential tips:

1. Use a waterproof case

While AirPods themselves aren’t waterproof, you can buy waterproof protective cases for the charging case. These covers add an extra layer of defense against accidental spills, rain, and humidity, helping to keep your AirPods safe when not in use. Some great options include:

  • Catalyst waterproof case for AirPods 3
  • Catalyst waterproof case for AirPods Pro 1 and 2
  • SUPCASE AirPods 4 waterproof case
  • Catalyst waterproof case for AirPods 1 and 2

2. Never use AirPods in wet environments

Keep your AirPods away from water sources like showers, swimming pools, or saunas. Even if you have an IPX4-rated model, prolonged exposure to steam or splashes can cause internal damage over time.

3. Store them in a dry place

When not in use, store your AirPods in their charging case in a cool and dry place. Avoid leaving them in humid areas like bathrooms or in places where they might be exposed to accidental spills, such as kitchen countertops.

4. Be cautious when exercising

Sweat can affect your AirPods over time, especially if it seeps into the speaker mesh or charging contacts. If you use AirPods during workouts, wipe them down with a dry, soft cloth after each session to prevent moisture buildup. It’s also a good habit to regularly clean your AirPods and charging case to remove any buildup.

What to do if your AirPods get wet?

Accidents happen, and if your AirPods get wet, it’s important to act fast.

  • Dry them immediately with a lint-free cloth.
  • Do not use heat (like a hairdryer) to dry them, as excessive heat can damage internal components.
  • Let them air dry in a well-ventilated area for at least 24 hours before using them again.
  • Avoid charging them until they are completely dry.

By taking these precautions, you can extend your AirPods’ lifespan and avoid costly replacements due to water damage. But if you’ve already dropped them in water, don’t panic! Check out our guide on what to do next.

Signing off

I hope this guide has answered all your questions about your AirPods’ water resistance levels. If there’s anything else you’d like to know, leave a comment, and I’ll get back to you.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.
