title.rendered: Starlink set to launch in India via partnership with Airtel and Jio

content.rendered:
Elon Musk’s SpaceX has partnered with Indian telecom giants Bharti Airtel and Reliance Jio to introduce Starlink, its satellite-based internet service, in India. The collaboration aims to boost internet accessibility, particularly in remote and underserved regions of the country.

According to Airtel’s press release, the collaboration “enables Airtel and SpaceX to further explore how Starlink can complement and expand Airtel’s offerings, and how Airtel’s expertise in the Indian market complements SpaceX’s direct offerings to consumers and businesses.”

Jio press release states that the partnership “enables Jio and SpaceX to explore how Starlink can extend Jio’s offerings and how Jio can complement SpaceX’s direct offerings to consumers and businesses.”

However, the rollout is subject to regulatory approvals, and Starlink must first secure authorization to offer its services in India.

As part of the agreement:

  • Jio will offer Starlink equipment through its retail stores and online channels, and also set up support infrastructure for installation, activation, and customer service.
  • Airtel has confirmed that it will make Starlink equipment available through its retail outlets, though it hasn’t disclosed further plans yet.

While both telecom providers already offer their own AirFiber broadband services, these are fundamentally different from Starlink. For context, Jio and Airtel AirFiber use 5G networks and Wi-Fi 6 technology to deliver high-speed internet. However, these services rely on strong local network coverage, which limits their availability to areas within the network range.

In contrast, Starlink uses a network of low Earth orbit (LEO) satellites to deliver high-speed internet across vast geographical areas, making it a better solution for remote and rural regions. There are over 7,000 operational Starlink satellites orbiting in space.

To access Starlink, users need to install an antenna with an unobstructed view of the sky, which allows it to connect with the LEO satellites and provide internet connectivity similar to a regular Wi-Fi service.

Starlink’s satellite connectivity is now available on iPhones as well. Check out our detailed guide on how to use Starlink satellite connectivity on iPhone for more information.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. title.rendered: iPad 11 vs. iPad 10: Should you upgrade?

content.rendered:
Amid the attention garnered by the M4 MacBook Air and the M3 iPad Air announcements, the base iPad update announcement largely went unnoticed. Sure, the upgrades to the new 11th-generation base iPad aren’t significant, but the ones it received are consequential, as the last refresh the lineup received was back in 2022.

But what’s really changed on the 11th-gen iPad? And do these changes warrant upgrading from the 10th-gen iPad? Let’s find out.

Table of Contents
  • iPad 11 vs. iPad 10: Specs comparison
  • iPad 11 vs. iPad 10: Key differences
    • Processor
    • Storage
    • Bluetooth connectivity
    • Pricing
  • Who should upgrade to the iPad 11?

iPad 11 vs. iPad 10: Specs comparison

Not much has changed on the iPad 11 compared to the iPad 10. The specs comparison table below should give you a better idea.

iPad 11 vs. iPad 10: Key differences

With the specs out of the way, let’s take a look at all the areas where the iPad 11 and iPad 10 differ.

Processor

The most significant upgrade the new iPad received is the chipset. It is now powered by an A16 processor with one less CPU and GPU core than the A16 powering the iPhone 14 Pro series and the iPhone 15. In comparison, the 10th-gen iPad used an A14 Bionic processor. This new chipset brings in a significant boost in performance and also enables the iPad for more software updates.

If you are worried about how this two-year-old chipset would perform, let me tell you it is good enough for a base iPad. I have the similar chip running on my iPhone 14 Pro, and it does everything I throw at it without any hiccups; even heavy games like PUBG mobile run smoothly. You can expect similar performance on the 11th-gen iPad. And with the larger surface area of the iPad enabling better heat dissipation, the A16 might even provide a better sustained performance.

Storage

Following the trend of increasing base storage, Apple bumped up the base storage of the new iPad to 128GB from 64 GB. It also added a 512GB variant, which wasn’t available in the previous model. The new base storage is a welcome change, as storage upgrades cost a lot on Apple products.

Bluetooth connectivity

With the upgraded chipset, the connectivity features also got a minor boost. The all-new iPad 11 supports Bluetooth 5.3 compared to Bluetooth 5.2 on the iPad 10. While you may not notice a performance difference in regular usage, the newer version should give you a better range when you connect the iPad to Bluetooth accessories like earphones, a mouse, or a keyboard.

Pricing

In another surprising move, Apple dropped the price of the new iPad, now starting at $349 for the base variant, which is $100 less than the launch price of the iPad 10th Gen. This is another welcome change for consumers, especially for student buyers, providing fantastic value for the price.

Who should upgrade to the iPad 11?

Those were some of the key upgrades in the new iPad 11th gen. The rest of the specs are exactly the same as the older model. You still get the same USB-C port, display, and cameras, and it even supports the same accessories.

If you own an iPad 10th-gen, it is not worth upgrading to iPad 11. You might probably won’t even notice anything different on the new version. However, you can consider upgrading if you use a 9th-gen or older iPad. In this case, you will get a USB-C port, a Center Stage supported front camera, and a much faster processor, all packaged in a refreshing new design.

Verdict

The iPad 11 is a great entry-level iPad. Anyone looking for an entertainment device, a gadget for the kids, school, or even for elders at home, can consider it. The bumped-up storage and reduced price also make it very easy to recommend. For this, I would say, “Well done, Apple!”

If you are confused about which iPad to get, our iPad buying guide can help you.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

content.rendered:
Easter is just around the corner, and that means all things pastel, cute bunnies, colorful eggs, and of course, religious devotion. To help you embrace the festivities, we’ve curated some perfect Easter wallpapers that can add a seasonal aesthetic to your iPhone.

From vibrant patterns to Spring-inspired designs, we’ve covered almost everything associated with Easter. Check them out below and add them to your celebrations.

Easter wallpapers for your iPhone

We’ve found some beautiful free Easter wallpapers for iPhone on WallpaperCave. These backgrounds perfectly complement the best Easter apps to help you embrace the festive spirit.

Click the links to download the high-quality images to your phone.

1. Colorful Easter Eggs

Decorative Easter eggs are the most iconic and beautiful symbol of the festival. With this colorful Easter egg iPhone wallpaper, add them to your screen for some festive cheer.

Download

2. Easter Bunnies

If you love animals, this cute Easter bunny wallpaper for your iPhone is a must-have. It’s sure to bring a smile to your face every time you glimpse your screen.

Download

3. Disney Easter wallpaper

Fun meets festivity in this Disney-themed Easter wallpaper that’s sure to delight your inner child. It’s got Mickey and Minnie Mouse along with colorful Easter eggs.

Download

4. Happy Easter minimalist wallpaper

Prefer keeping things simple with a minimalist wallpaper? Then here’s the perfect choice for you with subtle colors that’ll add just the right touch of festivity.

Download

5. He rose again Easter wallpaper

The soft pastel hues of this gradient wallpaper will give your iPhone screen a serene vibe. At the same time, the words “He rose again” are a powerful reminder of Easter’s significance.

Download

6. Spring Easter wallpaper

A beautiful thing about Easter is that it coincides with the changing seasons. Why not celebrate both occasions with this Spring wallpaper, which combines florals with Easter symbols?

Download

7. Cute Easter Bunny

Make way for the cutest Easter wallpaper we could find. This fluffy bunny with some festive eggs is sure to lift your mood.

Download

8. Easter greetings

Remind yourself of the most important Springtime holiday with this beautiful iPhone wallpaper featuring a Happy Easter message.

Download

9. Easter Quote from the Bible

If you’d like something more solemn, add this powerful Easter quote wallpaper to your screen. It’s sure to always remind you of Christ’s miracles.

Download

10. Bright Easter wallpaper

For lovers of all things pink, this Easter wallpaper adds a vibrant touch to your iPhone screen with dazzling florals and bold Easter Eggs.

Download

Signing off

We hope you’ve enjoyed these free Easter wallpapers. May this special time bring you joy and peace. Let us know what other wallpapers you’d like to see.

title.rendered: Download M4 MacBook Air Sky Blue Wallpaper in 4K Right Here

content.rendered:
Apple has once again impressed tech lovers with the launch of the new M4 MacBook Air, now available in a stunning sky blue color. But Apple didn’t stop there—they also introduced a matching sky blue wallpaper to complement its sleek design.

M4 MacBook Air Sky blue wallpaper

This new sky blue M4 MacBook Air has a beautiful metallic light blue color. It also reflects a dynamic gradient as light hits and bounces on its surface. To complement this, the official M4 MacBook Air wallpaper features a soft, radial gradient that blends beautifully with the sky blue finish. It makes your screen look elegant and fresh.

Download

Love this cool, calming shade, but are you not upgrading to the latest MacBook Air? You can still enjoy its stylish look by downloading the Radial Blue wallpaper. This wallpaper works perfectly on all MacBooks with different screen sizes and even Windows PCs.

Similar to the M2 MacBook Air wallpapers, Apple has released three different color options in this collection. So, if you’re not a fan of blue hues, you can choose from Radial Purple, Radial Yellow, and Radial Green, all featuring the same design. You can download the wallpapers using the Google Drive link.

Complete the look with matching accessories

Apple has gone the extra mile by introducing Sky Blue accessories to accompany the new MacBook Air. Now, you can build a fully color-coordinated setup with a Sky Blue MagSafe charging cable for a seamless charging experience.

You can also buy a clear protective case like the Incase hardshell case to keep your MacBook safe while showing off its beauty. These M4 MacBook Air accessories will give your entire workspace a polished, elegant look, aligning with Apple’s minimalist aesthetic.

Signing off

The sky blue M4 MacBook Air is not just a laptop; it’s a statement. Even if you don’t own one, you can still get this matching wallpaper for a stylish, premium feel. So, download the wallpaper today and bring a touch of Apple’s latest design trend to your device!

title.rendered: How to delete Reading List in Safari on iPhone, iPad, and Mac

content.rendered:
For times when you open an article but cannot read it immediately, Safari’s Reading List feature comes in handy, letting you save it so you can revisit it later. Over time, though, as you use the feature more regularly, you may end up with a cluttered Reading List.

Deleting items from your Reading List will help declutter it, making it easier to find what you are looking for. It will also help reclaim some storage space on your device or iCloud. Keep reading, and I will show you how to delete items from the Reading List on different Apple devices.

How to delete your Safari Reading List

Safari allows you to create a Reading List on all Apple devices. However, how you access and delete them differs on these devices. So, let’s look at how you can delete your Reading List in Safari on your iPhone, iPad, and Mac.

Note

If you have synced Safari to iCloud, deleting the Reading List on one device also removes it from all the devices signed into the same iCloud account.

Deleting Safari Reading List on iPhone or iPad

Many people prefer reading or browsing the internet on their iPhone or iPad. If you’re one of them, here’s how to clear your Safari Reading List on your device.

  1. Open Safari.
  2. Tap the bookmark button (with a book icon) at the bottom.
  3. Tap the glasses icon to bring up your Reading List.

  4. Swipe left on the article you want to delete and tap Delete to remove it from your Reading List.
  5. Alternatively, you can tap the Edit button in the bottom-right corner, select all the articles you want to remove, and tap Delete to remove them from your Reading List in one go.

Deleting Safari Reading List on Mac

For people who create a Reading List on their Mac, these are the steps you need to follow to clear your Reading List:

  1. Launch Safari.
  2. Click the rectangular icon in the upper-left corner to bring up the sidebar.
  3. Click Reading List in the lower-left corner to access your saved articles. Alternatively, you can access the Reading List from Files > Show Reading List.

  4. Now, Control-click on the article you want to remove and click Delete. Or click Clear All Items to remove all the items from the list.

How to stop syncing Safari Reading List to iCloud

While you cannot specifically disable just the Reading List from syncing to iCloud, you can turn off the whole sync for Safari to keep its data like bookmarks, history, and Reading List confined to the specific device you are using it on. This is what you need to do:

  1. Open System Settings on your Mac.
  2. Click your Apple Account at the top.
  3. Click iCloud, and under Saved to iCloud, click See All.

  4. Now, locate Safari and flip the toggle next to it off.

That’s all! Your Safari data will no longer be synced to your iCloud, and your Reading List will remain on your Mac.

Signing off

It is important to keep your browser data organized. Doing so ensures you do not suddenly end up with a ton of bookmarks, history, and Reading List items cluttering your browser and hampering your experience.

So, go ahead and clear your Safari Reading List today. While at it, you can also clear Safari cache, history, and cookies to improve its performance.

FAQs

Can I recover a deleted item from my Reading List?

You can only recover if you have a Time Machine backup set on your Mac.

Does clearing my Reading List improve Safari’s performance?

Yes, clearing the Reading List frees up storage, which can improve performance.

Does the Reading List take up storage on my device?

Yes, Reading List does take up storage on your device.

Can I turn off the Reading List feature in Safari?

You cannot turn it off, but you can choose not to use the feature altogether.

  • How to change the default search engine in Safari
  • How to use Safari Highlights in macOS Sequoia
  • How to block websites in Safari

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

mainEntity.name: Can I connect AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, you can connect your AirPods to a PC or Windows laptop as long as they offer Bluetooth connectivity. Enabling the pairing mode on the AirPods allows you to find them on your PC via the Bluetooth settings.

mainEntity.name: Why do my AirPods keep disconnecting from my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Chromebook’s Bluetooth is broken, your AirPods may keep disconnecting. Toggle Bluetooth on/off on the Chromebook, or restart both the AirPods and the Chromebook to try again. Make sure your AirPods are charged and properly paired with your Chromebook. You may need to unpair and re-pair your AirPods.

mainEntity.name: How do I check my AirPods battery on my Chromebook?

acceptedAnswer.text: Navigate to the taskbar and click the Network icon to view the Bluetooth tile. When your AirPods are connected, it will show up here along with the remaining battery life.

aioseo_head_json.author_bio:
"The founder of iGeeksBlog, Dhvanesh, is an Apple aficionado, who cannot stand even a slight innuendo about Apple products. He dons the cap of editor-in-chief to make sure that articles match the quality standard before they are published."

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Dhvanesh's dedication to the Apple community goes a step further. Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: The best music streaming apps I’ve tried on iPhone

content.rendered:
Whatever I’m doing throughout the day, I need to have some music playing along. So, I’ve tried all the best music streaming apps on my iPhone to find the truly worthy ones. Whether you’re looking for a free music app for iPhone without a subscription or an app that delivers high-quality audio, this handy guide has you covered. Check out my top recommendations below.

Best music streaming apps

You have plenty of options to choose from when it comes to top iPhone and iPad music apps. But if you don’t want to waste your time with the wrong ones, here are my top picks after hundreds of hours of testing.

1. Apple Music – Best music app for iPhone

Of course, I have to begin with my go-to app for music on my iPhone, Apple Music. It’s definitely the winner for anyone looking for a seamless, high-quality listening experience.

With an extensive library of over 100 million songs, it can match every musical taste, from classics and the latest hits to lesser-known indie gems and experimental releases. It’s the ideal music streaming app if you’re immersed in the Apple ecosystem, as it integrates flawlessly with iOS, macOS, Apple Watch, and HomePod. Features include automatic syncing across devices.

You can make the most of Siri voice control and get personalized recommendations. Moreover, if you’re an audiophile, you’ll appreciate the lossless audio and spatial sound that offers unmatched clarity and depth on your Apple device.

2. Spotify – The best free music app without a subscription

Coming to the next most popular music streaming app, Spotify is the best choice if you want a free music app that’ll allow you to discover new music and podcasts from around the world.

I really appreciate the powerful personalization features, like Discover Weekly and Daily Mixes. The app curates playlists tailored to your tastes, making every listening session feel fresh. With offline listening, you can download your favorite songs and episodes to enjoy anywhere, even without an internet connection. However, you’ll need to be a paid subscriber to enjoy that feature.

Spotify’s user-friendly interface and smart recommendations make it a great app. Moreover, in addition to the music, I love the vast selection of podcasts, including exclusive shows and original content.

3. YouTube Music – Enjoy a vast music library

If you’re addicted to YouTube like me, YouTube Music is probably the best music streaming app for you. Its integration with YouTube’s vast library stands out, allowing you to switch effortlessly between audio tracks and music videos.

Moreover, it gives you access to musical content that you wouldn’t find anywhere else, such as live performances, remixes, covers by smaller artists, experimental mashups, soundscapes, and more.

If you sign up for a YouTube Premium subscription, you can enjoy features like offline downloads, background play, and of course, an ad-free experience.

4. Amazon Music – Enjoy high-quality spatial audio

Amazon Music is the best music app for iPhone if you’re already an Amazon Prime member or want to take advantage of Prime benefits. With a vast library of songs, it offers a great mix of popular hits and lesser-known treasures, along with thousands of curated playlists and stations. But what takes it up a notch is the access to lossless audio and spatial sound for an immersive listening experience.

Moreover, this app boasts seamless integration with Alexa, allowing hands-free control for effortless playback. So, if you’re already in the Amazon ecosystem or looking for a music app with excellent sound quality and voice control, Amazon Music is the way to go.

5. Tidal

Tidal is an iPhone music app designed for audiophiles, it offers HiFi and lossless audio, delivering studio-quality sound that preserves every detail of a track. So, you can enjoy millions of songs in HiRes lossless sound quality up to 24-bit, 192 kHz and Dolby Atmos.

Moreover, it offers a library of millions of songs, mixes and playlists curated by TIDAL editors and music fans worldwide.

There’s also tons of exclusive content, including early releases, artist-curated playlists, and behind-the-scenes footage. So if you prioritize top-tier audio fidelity and want to support artists with higher payouts, Tidal is your best bet. It offers a free 30-day trial so you can test it out before subscribing.

Signing off.

You’re spoilt for choice when it comes to music streaming apps on your iPhone or iPad. But it makes life easy and efficient when you pick the best one based on your unique needs and preferences. I hope this article has helped you make the perfect choice. Let me know in the comments below if you need any more insights.

FAQs

What is the best free music app for iPhone?

The best music app depends on your needs and preferences, but Apple Music is the best music streaming app if you’re in the Apple ecosystem.

Can I download music for offline listening on iPhone and iPad?

Yes, most music streaming apps on your iPhone or iPad allow downloads for offline listening. This includes Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music, and more.

What is the best app for listening to music without Wi-Fi?

Many apps offer this feature. Apple Music is a great app that lets you download music to your device to listen without an internet connection.

What’s the best music streaming app for Apple ecosystem users?

Apple Music is a great choice because it offers a huge music library, a high-quality listening experience, and easy sync between different Apple devices.

Can I use these music apps with Siri?

If you want to command Siri to play music, Apple Music is the best app to use as it seamlessly integrates within the Apple ecosystem.

Are there any music apps that support Dolby Atmos and Spatial Audio?

Yes, TIDAL is a great music app that is specifically designed for high-quality music streaming with Dolby Atmos and Spatial Audio.

  •  How to authorize your Mac for Apple Music
  • How to cancel your Apple Music subscription

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Music is a great choice because it offers a huge music library, a high-quality listening experience, and easy sync between different Apple devices.

mainEntity.name: Can I use these music apps with Siri?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you want to command Siri to play music, Apple Music is the best app to use as it seamlessly integrates within the Apple ecosystem.

mainEntity.name: Are there any music apps that support Dolby Atmos and Spatial Audio?

title.rendered: How to install Homebrew on Mac (macOS M1/M2/ M3/M4)

content.rendered:
Homebrew is an open-source package manager that makes it easy for Mac users to install software using the command line. If you’re a programmer, enjoy using the command line, or just want a simpler way to install software on your Mac, this piece is for you.

With Homebrew, you can install nearly any open-source program or package, including Python, Ruby, MongoDB, PHP, Git, Node.js, and even casks like Slack, VLC, and many more. In this article, I’ll walk you through the step-by-step process to install Homebrew on your Mac, along with how to use it. But before that, let’s quickly go over what Homebrew is and the installation requirements.

What is Homebrew?

Homebrew is a package manager for macOS that makes it easy to install, update, and manage applications, programming languages, and utilities on a Mac using the command line. According to its developers, Homebrew “installs the stuff you need that Apple didn’t.”

This package manager is an open-source project developed and maintained by a large community of contributors. It helps install apps and handles dependencies, ensuring that all required packages are installed correctly.

While the App Store is great for installing all sorts of applications on your Mac, you won’t find most open-source software and tools—often available on GitHub—there. So, Homebrew is a piece of software used to install and manage other software packages on your Mac.

Think of it as the app store for command-line tools, libraries, and casks (GUI applications)—it makes software installation much easier. You simply run a command in your terminal to install the software you need and manage the app—update, uninstall, and more.

Benefits of using Homebrew

The fact is, using Homebrew makes installing software a lot easier, especially if you’re comfortable running a few simple commands—that’s the main advantage of using it on a Mac. Here are all the main benefits of using Homebrew on Mac:

  • Easy Installation: Homebrew makes installing software super simple—just run a command, and you’re done. There is no need for manual downloads or setups.
  • Huge Software Selection: You can install a wide range of open-source tools, programming languages, libraries, and even GUI apps (casks). It allows you access to a huge repository of software not readily available through the Apps Store.
  • Automatic Dependency Handling: Homebrew automatically handles all the required libraries and tools, so everything you install works smoothly.
  • Quick Updates and Uninstalls: It makes updating or removing software fast and hassle-free with just a command, keeping your system organized and up-to-date.
  • Strong Community Support: Homebrew is open-source and backed by a huge community, meaning you get frequent updates and access to tons of software.

Requirements to use Homebrew on Mac

Before discussing how you can install Homebrew on your Mac, here are the software installation requirements According to Homebrew Installation Documentation:

  • CPU/Chipset: Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) or a 64-bit Intel processor
  • Operating System: macOS 13 (Ventura) or newer is ideal. macOS 10.11 (El Capitan) to 12 (Monterey) aren’t supported but might still work. Anything older won’t run Homebrew.
  • Command Line Tools (CLT): Xcode, Terminal
  • Shell: Any Bourne-compatible shell like Bash, zsh, or fish

How to install Homebrew on macOS M1/M2/M3/M4

Here are the steps to install Homebrew on your Mac:

1. Ensure your Mac meets the system requirements

Make sure your Mac has an Apple Silicon chip (M1, M2, M3, M4) or a 64-bit Intel processor. Also, confirm you’re running macOS 13 (Ventura) or later to make the Homebrew installation process smoother. If you’re unsure how to update, check out our guide on upgrading to macOS Sequoia.

2. Install Command Line Tools for Xcode

To use Homebrew on Mac, you’ll need to install CLT for Xcode. Xcode is Apple’s app development and programming suite, but you only need the command line tools for Homebrew. These tools enable your Mac to support some of the package components Homebrew relies on.

To install Command Line Tools for Xcode:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac using Launchpad or Spotlight Search. You can also open Terminal from Finder → Applications → Utilities.
  2. Type xcode-select --install in the Terminal then hit the Return key.

  3. After entering the code, if you don’t have Xcode previously installed on your Mac, you’ll get a prompt. Click Install.

  4. Go through the License Agreement, then click Agree.

  5. If the Mac is not connected to power, you’ll be prompted to do so. You may click Continue on Battery Power If your Mac’s battery is at 50% or above.

  6. Once the Xcode command line tools are downloaded and installed, click Done.

Note If you don’t install Xcode Command Line Tools before setting up Homebrew, you’ll still be prompted to do so during the installation process.

3. Install Homebrew from its GitHub repository

Once you have Command Line Tools for Xcode ready, you can use the Terminal on your Mac to fetch Homebrew from its official GitHub repository. Here are the steps to follow:

  1. Open the Terminal app on your Mac.
  2. Go to the official Homebrew website and copy the installation command provided under “Install Homebrew”:

    /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"

  3. In the Terminal window, paste the command and press Return.
  4. When prompted, enter your Mac’s password and press Return to proceed. Keep in mind that you won’t see anything appear on your screen as you type your password.
  5. After correctly entering your password, you’ll be presented with the list of every that’ll be installed. Press Return again to confirm the installation.
  6. Once the installation is complete, you’ll see a “Installation successful” message in the Terminal.

4. Add Homebrew to your PATH

After installing Homebrew, you may need to add it to your shell’s PATH. This makes finding, installing, using, and managing software packages easier.

If you choose to skip this step, you can still use Homebrew, but you’ll have to specify its installation directory every time you access it in the Terminal. To save yourself some hassle, here’s how to add Homebrew to your PATH;

  1. Open the Terminal app on your Mac.
  2. Paste the following commands one by one, pressing Return after each:
    • cd /opt/homebrew/bin/
    • ls
    • PATH=$PATH:/opt/homebrew/bin
    • cd
    • touch .zshrc
    • echo 'export PATH=$PATH:/opt/homebrew/bin' >> .zshrc

  3. After updating the PATH, run the following command to ensure everything is working properly:
    • brew doctor
  4. If everything is set up correctly, you should see the message: “Your system is ready to brew.”

That’s it! You can verify if Homebrew has been installed correctly and get moving!

5. Verify if Homebrew is installed correctly

After installing Homebrew on your Mac, it’s a good idea to verify that the installation was successful. Here’s how to do that:

  1. Open the Terminal app on your Mac.
  2. Type brew --version in the Terminal window and press Return.

  3. If Homebrew is installed correctly, you’ll see its version number displayed.
  4. If the command doesn’t work, type brew doctor and hit Return. This command will check your Homebrew installation for any potential issues.
  5. If you see the version number from the brew --version command, it means Homebrew is installed properly. If you get an error message from the brew doctor command, follow the instructions provided to resolve any issues and try again.

Pro Tip

Homebrew now offers a .pkg installer on GitHub for installation without running commands in Terminal. However, this method isn’t as simplified as using the GitHub command. If you prefer to install Homebrew using its .pkg installer, you can download it from its official page on GitHub.

How to install packages on Mac with Homebrew

This is where all the hard work pays off. Once Homebrew is successfully installed on your Mac, follow these steps to quickly find and install the apps of your choice:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac.
  2. Type brew search (SearchTerm) into the Terminal window and press the Return key. Replace (SearchTerm) with the package you’re looking for. So if you want to search Firefox, for example, you’ll type brew search firefox.

  3. Type brew info (PackageName) and hit Return to retrieve details about a package. Replace (PackageName) with the name of the package.

  4. Type brew install (PackageName) into the Terminal window and press Return to install a package. Replace (PackageName) with the name of the package. In my case, I’m installing the FireFox browser, so I’ve typed brew search firefox,.

After you install software using Homebrew, it will automatically show up in the Launchpad. But if you want to access the downloaded packages (known as casks), you can find them under /opt/homebrew/caskroom in Finder.

How to uninstall packages with Homebrew

If you want to uninstall or delete specific packages or apps on your Mac, you can easily do so by following these steps:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac.
  2. Type brew list into the Terminal window and press Return. This command will list all the apps you installed via Homebrew.

  3. Type brew uninstall (PackageName) into the Terminal window and hit the Return key. Replace (PackageName) with the name of the package. In this case, we’re removing the FireFox browser, so we’ve typed brew uninstall firefox.

How to turn off Homebrew analytics

Homebrew, while open-source, collects and shares analytical data to help improve the tool. If you prefer not to contribute or share your data, you can turn off Homebrew analytics:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac.
  2. Type brew analytics off into the Terminal window and press Return.

How to update apps with Homebrew

Homebrew also provides an easy way to keep your apps updated. Here’s how you can do this:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac.
  2. Type brew outdated into the Terminal window and press Return. This command lists all the apps that need to be updated.
  3. Type brew upgrade (PackageName) into the Terminal window and press Return. Replace (PackageName) with the name of the app you want to update.

To update all apps at once, just type brew upgrade and hit Return.

How to update Homebrew on Mac

Like any other app, Homebrew receives periodic updates. To keep it updated:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac.
  2. Type brew update into the Terminal window and press Return.

How to uninstall Homebrew on Mac

If you no longer need Homebrew and want to remove it from your Mac, follow these quick steps:

  1. Open Terminal on your Mac.
  2. Paste the following command into the Terminal window and press Return:

    /bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/uninstall.sh)"

  3. Type y in the Terminal window and press Return.

  4. Enter your Mac’s password, and then Homebrew will be uninstalled.

After that, Homebrew will be uninstalled from your Mac.

Wrapping up…

Homebrew offers a seamless way to manage apps on Mac, regardless of whether you’re a developer, sysadmin, or regular user. If you want to install Homebrew on your Mac, the steps outlined in this guide can help. However, if you’re facing any difficulties with installing Homebrew, you can restart the whole installation process.

Also, let us know what you think about Homebrew. Do you see yourself using it regularly, or do you prefer installing packages on your Mac manually?

FAQs

Is it necessary to install Homebrew on my Mac?

It’s not essential to install Homebrew on your Mac. However, Homebrew can be a valuable tool for quickly downloading applications and developer tools on your device without fiddling around in a web browser.

Can I use Homebrew to install apps with a GUI?

Yes, of course. In addition to installing developer tools like git, Homebrew can also be used to install apps with a graphical user interface. However, it’s recommended that you install the Homebrew cask to manage GUI applications efficiently.

Where is Homebrew installed on Mac?

Unless specified otherwise during the installation, Homebrew is typically installed at /opt/homebrew (on Apple Silicon Macs) or /usr/local/bin (on Intel Macs).

Is Homebrew available for M2 Mac?

Yes. Homebrew can be installed on all M1/M2/M3/M4 Apple Silicon and Intel Macs that support at least macOS Big Sur or later versions of macOS, such as Ventura and Sonoma.

You may also read:

  • Most useful Terminal commands for macOS
  • How to open a Mac app from an unidentified developer

title.rendered: iOS 18.4 Beta 3 released – What’s new?

content.rendered:
Apple has rolled out the third developer beta of iOS 18.4. This update comes with build number 22E5222f. It was released a week after Apple rolled out the second developer beta of iOS 18.4. Apple is also seeding the third developer beta updates for iPadOS 18.4, macOS 15.4, watchOS 11.4, tvOS 18.4, and visionOS 2.4 alongside the iOS 18.4 beta 3.

If you’re enrolled in the developer program, you can update your iPhone to iOS 18.4 beta 3 by heading to Settings → General → Software Update.

Unlike previous beta versions of iOS 18.4, the third beta doesn’t come with many new features. The “Subscriptions & Payments” option in the dropdown menu of the wallet app has been replaced with the “Preauthorized Payments” option.

There’s a new Show Banner toggle that allows users to disable the Back Tap banner. This banner was introduced with the first beta of iOS 18.4 and there was no way to disable it until this update. Now you can head to Settings > Accesibility > Touch > Back Tap > Show Banner. These are the two new features introduced with iOS 18.4 beta 3.

With iOS 18.4, Apple is introducing several new features on the iPhone. The first developer beta build of iOS 18.4 introduced Apple Intelligence features like Priority Notifications, Sketch Style in Image Playground, and expanded Apple Intelligence support to more languages, including French, German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Japanese, Korean, and Simplified Chinese, along with localized English for Singapore and India.

Additionally, Apple News+ subscribers can now access a Food section in the app, featuring numerous recipes, healthy eating tips, and more from top publishers in the industry. The update also added a few Ambient Music toggles to the Control Center, along with new Podcast widgets.

The second developer beta of iOS 18.4 added support for Visual Intelligence on the iPhone 15 Pro series via the Action Button. It also introduced a new set of emojis, made some changes to Priority Notifications, added Apple Intelligence toggles in the Control Center, new Shortcut Actions, and the ability to pause downloads in the App Store. Moreover, Apple also added a dedicated Vision Pro.

Apart from the aforementioned features, Apple has introduced several other changes in the iOS 18.4 beta updates. These features are currently being refined and are likely to make their way into the final public build of iOS 18.4. Apple is expected to release iOS 18.4, along with iPadOS 18.4, in early April. Although delays are still possible.

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

mainEntity.name: Can I use an Apple Watch with a carrier different from my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. If you switch carriers, you must remove the existing plan and set up a new one in the Watch app under Cellular.

title.rendered: Here Are 10+ Best Accessories for Your New M3 iPad Air

content.rendered:
Got your hands on the new M3 iPad Air? Now, if you’re looking for accessories, you’ve come to the right place. From must-have protection to productivity-boosting add-ons, I’ve rounded up the best accessories to help you get the most out of your M3 iPad Air. Let’s dive in!

Key factors to consider when buying accessories for M3 iPad Air

Choosing the right accessories for your new iPad Air depends on how you use your device. Whether you need better protection, improved productivity, or a more comfortable setup, here are the key factors to consider before making a purchase.

1. Protection and durability: Keep your iPad safe

Your iPad is a premium device, so protecting it should be a priority. A screen protector like the ESR Tempered Glass prevents scratches and smudges, while a privacy screen protector ensures no one peeks at your display.

If you’re concerned about bumps and drops, you should get a protective case like the ProCase Smart folio. It safeguards both the back glass and screen and also works as a kickstand.

2. Portability: Carry it with ease

For users who frequently take their iPad on the go, a good sleeve keeps it secure while traveling. Some sleeves also have compartments for carrying additional accessories. You’ll also want a compact charger like the Anker USB-C charger to ensure your device stays powered up wherever you are.

3. Productivity and work efficiency: Turn your iPad into a workhorse

If you use your iPad for work or studies, a keyboard case is a game-changer. The Apple Magic Keyboard provides a laptop-like experience. I also use a USB hub to expand my connectivity with extra ports for seamless multitasking.

Moreover, every iPad user, whether you are a student, professional, creator, or casual user, should take advantage of the Apple Pencil features. You can pair it with an iPad stand for a more ergonomic drawing or working experience.

4. Entertainment: Enjoy every moment

Regardless of your workflow, you will never regret purchasing wireless earbuds or headphones for your iPad. Apart from listening to music or taking FaceTime calls, good headphones also allow you to eliminate distracting sounds with ANC. Moreover, they enable better music creation or video editing experience.

As I often watch movies, listen to music, or make video calls on my iPad, I use high-quality Beats Studio Pro headphones. Need extra storage for your media? You can get a portable SSD to ensure you never run out of space.

With the above factors in mind, I scoured the internet to find the best sleeves, cases, styluses, keyboards, chargers, and more for your M3 iPad Air. Go through the descriptions of each and pick products that perfectly meet your requirements!

Best must-have accessories for M3 iPad Air

Here are my recommendations for iPad Air accessories. Make sure to check the size before buying, as the M3 iPad Air comes in two sizes: 11-inch and 13-inch. Moreover, most accessories are compatible with the M2 iPad Air as well.

M3 iPad Air screen protectors for ultimate protection

iPad Air display has a fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating and antireflective coating to provide the best visuals. To keep it in pristine condition, get the ESR screen protector. It offers robust protection against scratches and smudges. The 9H tempered glass ensures clarity and responsiveness to touches and Apple Pencil.

For those who prioritize privacy, the ESR privacy screen protector is a must-have. It safeguards your screen from prying eyes at a 30-degree angle, making it ideal for use in public spaces. Moreover, thanks to its magnetic attachment, you can detach the film and re-use it.

iPad Air cases for optimal protection

A durable case is vital to protect your device from daily wear and tear. The Apple Smart folio is specifically designed for the M3 iPad Air, offering seamless integration and reliable protection. You can also fold the front cover to use it as a stand for better viewing.

For budget-conscious users, the ProCase Smart folio provides similar protection without compromising on quality. The back cover is smudging-free and fingerprint-proof. Moreover, thanks to its ultralightweight and sleek design, it is easy to carry.

If you prefer to showcase your iPad’s sleek design, the Fintie Hybrid slim clear cover offers transparent protection with soft TPU bumper corners. It also has auto sleep and wake technology, so your iPad screen turns off when you put the cover on, saving the battery.

Best sleeves for safe & stylish portability

If you frequently travel or use your iPad Air during your daily commute, protecting it with just a case won’t cut it. You should invest in a good sleeve to ensure maximum protection against drops and dust particles that might have accumulated in your bag.

To help you choose something that fits your lifestyle, I have come up with options from two brands—MoKo and tomtoc. The MoKo sleeve case offers a simple envelope made of PU leather, which you can slide your iPad into. Meanwhile, the tomtoc 360° protective sleeve uses synthetic fabric, offers a more modern look with a zipper, and features a pocket for storing other accessories.

To sum up, if you are on a tighter budget or like the aesthetic appeal of leather, you may choose the sleeve by MoKo. On the other hand, if you’d like the extra functionality of a pocket, you may shell out a bit more and get the tomtoc sleeve. Neither will disappoint you.

Chargers and USB bubs for enhanced connectivity

Since Apple doesn’t provide a charger for new iPad models in the European Union, chargers have become a hot commodity. Even if you live elsewhere, you won’t regret having a good charger in your arsenal of iPad accessories.

I would personally suggest using UGreen’s 65W Nexode USB-C charger with your brand-new iPad Air. This dual-port USB-C charger can power up to three devices at once while smartly managing the charging speeds. Meanwhile, the GaN (Gallium Nitride) tech keeps the charger portable and power-efficient.

Investing in quality USB hubs is vital to keeping your iPad powered and connected. For expanded connectivity, the Anker 5-in-1 USB-C hub adds extra ports, including HDMI and USB-A, enhancing the iPad’s versatility. So, you can connect a 4K display and transfer files at 5Gbps speed.

Keyboard cases for a laptop-like experience

Apple’s Magic keyboard case has its own appeal. It offers a seamless typing experience with its responsive keys and integrated trackpad. But when one looks at the price tag, its appeal quickly fades away. As a worthy and more affordable alternative, I’d suggest the ESR Rebound Magnetic keyboard case for iPad Air.

This magnetic keyboard case can help boost your productivity by elevating your typing and scrolling experience and providing comfortable viewing angles. Plus, thanks to its detachable back cover, when you are done typing, you can use it as a standalone protective case for your iPad Air.

For those seeking additional protection while on the move, the ZAGG rugged book keyboard case offers a durable build without sacrificing functionality. The company claims it can endure up to 6.6ft drops. Moreover, the wireless keyboard can be paired to your iPad and iPhone simultaneously via Bluetooth.

If you are a power user and require more flexibility, pairing the iPad with a wireless keyboard like the Apple Magic keyboard enhances typing comfort. Additionally, incorporating the Logitech Pebble combo facilitates multitasking, providing a desktop-like experience.

Apple Pencil for note-takers and artists

The Apple Pencil is an invaluable tool for students, professionals, and artists alike. For most iPad Air users, the Apple Pencil (2nd Generation) offers precision and responsiveness. So, you can jot down notes or sketch effortlessly.

Apple also offers an advanced Apple Pencil Pro with enhanced pressure sensitivity and tilt recognition, catering to intricate artistic needs. Therefore, if you use your iPad Air to bring your ideas to life, you must get it to enjoy its unique gestures.

iPad Air stands for desk use

Do you wish to use your iPad hands-free for various tasks? An iPad Air stand is a must for maintaining ergonomic comfort during extended use. The Twelve South HoverBar Duo is a versatile stand, perfect for video calling, following recipes, watching content, or using Sidecar with your Mac.

You can also get a floor stand like the Lamicall tablet floor stand to set your iPad Air at adjustable angles, ensuring optimal viewing positions for presentations or watching videos.

Headphones for crisp music and calls

The AirPods Pro (2nd generation) is ideal for casual users. It offers a blend of great audio sound quality with long battery life, support for ANC, and Spatial Audio. Additionally, the IP54 protection against dust, water, and sweat helps ensure that you can use the earbuds comfortably regardless of the use case.

However, if you are more of a creative user, Beats Studio Pro is just perfect. Its over-the-ear design creates a fuller sound and supports ANC and almost all other features offered by the AirPods Pro (2nd generation). Further, Beats Studio Pro has a USB-C port, which can be used to connect via a cable.

External SSD for Extra Storage On-the-Go

If you like editing videos and photos on the go, the SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD offers the perfect combination of utility and protection. This portable SSD delivers 1050MB/s of read and 1000MB/s of write speeds for quick file transfers.

It also has a rugged enclosure that offers up to 3 meters of drop protection and IP65 water—and dust resistance. SanDisk Extreme Portable SSDs are available in storage capacities ranging from 500GB to 4TB. This ensures that you can easily store your photos and videos without worrying about accidentally losing your data.

Signing off

The right accessories can transform your M3 iPad Air into a powerful tool that fits your lifestyle. Whether you need protection, productivity boosters, or entertainment upgrades, these carefully chosen accessories ensure you get the most out of your device. Invest in the ones that match your needs and enjoy an even better iPad experience!

mainEntity.name: Why is my cellular data not working on my Apple Watch?

acceptedAnswer.text: An inactive cellular plan, zero network reception area, or a disabled cellular network might be among the reasons why cellular data isn't working on your Apple Watch.

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you can not. Your Apple Watch and iPhone share the same phone number, meaning the watch cannot independently function with a different carrier.

mainEntity.name: Can I make calls and send texts without my iPhone nearby?

acceptedAnswer.text: If your Apple Watch has an active mobile plan and is connected to the cellular network, you can make calls and send text messages without the paired iPhone nearby.

mainEntity.name: Does Apple Watch support international roaming?

acceptedAnswer.text: Apple Watch cellular support varies by region and carrier. Check with your provider for roaming support.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I remove or switch my cellular plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you remove your cellular plan from your Apple Watch, it will no longer have independent cellular connectivity unless it is connected to Wi-Fi and your iPhone via Bluetooth. @graph.name: ESR Screen Protector for iPad Air
@graph.description: It offers robust protection against scratches and smudges. The 9H tempered glass ensures clarity and responsiveness to touches and Apple Pencil.

@graph.name: ESR Privacy Screen Protector for iPad Air
@graph.description: It safeguards your screen from prying eyes at a 30-degree angle, making it ideal for use in public spaces. Moreover, thanks to its magnetic attachment, you can detach the film and re-use it.

@graph.name: Apple Smart Folio for iPad Air
@graph.description: The Apple Smart folio is specifically designed for the M3 iPad Air, offering seamless integration and reliable protection. You can also fold the front cover to use it as a stand for better viewing.

@graph.name: ProCase Smart Case for iPad Air
@graph.description: For budget-conscious users, the ProCase Smart folio provides similar protection without compromising on quality. The back cover is smudging-free and fingerprint-proof. Moreover, thanks to its ultralightweight and sleek design, it is easy to carry.

@graph.name: Fintie Hybrid Slim Case for iPad Air
@graph.description: If you prefer to showcase your iPad’s sleek design, the Fintie Hybrid slim clear cover offers transparent protection with soft TPU bumper corners. It also has auto sleep and wake technology, so your iPad screen turns off when you put the cover on, saving the battery.

@graph.name: MoKo PU Leather iPad Air Sleeve Case
@graph.description: Made of PU leather exterior, which is sleek and smooth. Built-in soft felt lining to prevent your device from being shocked while it is falling by accident. It can give your iPad plenty of protection.

@graph.name: tomtoc 11 Inch Protective Case Sleeve
@graph.description: Featuring a concise and conceptual minimalist design, the bag remains slim and lightweight, the Light-B18 tomtoc tablet sleeve effortlessly carries your device without excess bulk and can be conveniently stowed in another bag, backpack, or suitcase

@graph.name: UGREEN Nexode 65W GaN USB-C Wall Charger
@graph.description: This dual-port USB-C charger can power up to three devices at once while smartly managing the charging speeds. Meanwhile, the GaN (Gallium Nitride) tech keeps the charger portable and power-efficient.

@graph.name: Anker USB C Hub
@graph.description: The Anker 5-in-1 USB-C hub adds extra ports, including HDMI and USB-A, enhancing the iPad’s versatility. So, you can connect a 4K display and transfer files at 5Gbps speed.

@graph.name: Apple Magic Keyboard
@graph.description: The perfect companion for iPad Pro and iPad Air, Magic Keyboard features a great typing experience, a trackpad, backlit keys, a USB‑C port for pass‑through charging, and front and back protection.

@graph.name: ESR Rebound Magnetic Keyboard Case
@graph.description: Upgrade your iPad to getting-stuff-done mode by transforming it into a portable productivity machine and be ready to work whenever, wherever. Ultra-strong magnets seamlessly combine case and tablet to let you easily open the floating cantilever stand to the perfect angle for typing or browsing.

@graph.name: ZAGG Pro Keys 2 Keyboard Case
@graph.description: The polycarbonate case features rubberized edges and corner bumpers, providing 6.6 ft (2m) of drop protection for your iPad, ensuring durability and peace of mind in any environment

@graph.name: Apple Magic Keyboard
@graph.description: If you are a power user and require more flexibility, pairing the iPad with a wireless keyboard like the Apple Magic keyboard enhances typing comfort.

@graph.name: Logitech Pebble 2 Combo
@graph.description: The Logitech Pebble combo facilitates multitasking, providing a desktop-like experience.

@graph.name: Apple Pencil 2nd Generation
@graph.description: For most iPad Air users, the Apple Pencil (2nd Generation) offers precision and responsiveness. So, you can jot down notes or sketch effortlessly.

@graph.name: Apple Pencil Pro
@graph.description: Apple also offers an advanced Apple Pencil Pro with enhanced pressure sensitivity and tilt recognition, catering to intricate artistic needs.

@graph.name: Lamicall Tablet Floor Stand Holder
@graph.description: You can also get a floor stand like the Lamicall tablet floor stand to set your iPad Air at adjustable angles, ensuring optimal viewing positions for presentations or watching videos.

@graph.name: Apple AirPods Pro 2
@graph.description: It offers a blend of great audio sound quality with long battery life, support for ANC, and Spatial Audio. Additionally, the IP54 protection against dust, water, and sweat helps ensure that you can use the earbuds comfortably regardless of the use case.

@graph.name: Beats Studio Pro
@graph.description: Its over-the-ear design creates a fuller sound and supports ANC and almost all other features offered by the AirPods Pro (2nd generation). Further, Beats Studio Pro has a USB-C port, which can be used to connect via a cable.

@graph.name: SanDisk 2TB Extreme Portable SSD
@graph.description: If you like editing videos and photos on the go, the SanDisk Extreme Portable SSD offers the perfect combination of utility and protection. This portable SSD delivers 1050MB/s of read and 1000MB/s of write speeds for quick file transfers.

title.rendered: How to find trending audio on Instagram and go viral

content.rendered:
Adding trending audio to your Instagram Reel is an effective way to make it go viral. Popular sounds can boost engagement, increase discoverability, and help your content reach a wider audience.

However, the difficult part is that these trends change constantly. So, how do you stay ahead and find the best audio for your Instagram Reels? Keep reading to learn how to find trending audio on Instagram to create Reels that go viral.

What is the relevance of trending audio on Instagram? 

Whether you are a popular creator, influencer, or casual user, if you want your Instagram content to reach the masses, there’s nothing better than using trending audio on the platform. Here’s how using trending audio on Instagram helps:

  • Increases discoverability: Instagram’s algorithm is known to boost Reels that use trending audio.  
  • Boosts engagement: The audience is more likely to watch and interact with your Instagram post or Reel if it has trending audio. 
  • Keeps content relevant: Staying updated with trends helps maintain a fresh and engaging feed, keeping your content relevant and attracting new audiences. 

8 ways to find trending audio on Instagram 

From built-in features to using external tools to analyze the top audio, multiple methods exist to find out the top trending sounds on Instagram.

1. Explore the Instagram Reels tab 

Finding trending music for Instagram Reels isn’t rocket science; you only need to keep a keen eye while scrolling Reels on the platform. Here’s how:

  1. Open the Instagram app and hit the Reels button in the bottom menu bar.
  2. Scroll through Reels and look for sounds with a small arrow pointing diagonally upwards next to the audio name.
  3. Tap the audio, and you will see a Trending tag on the subsequent screen, along with the number of times the audio has been used on Instagram.

2. Check the Instagram audio library 

If swiping up on multiple reels to find the right audio feels like a hassle, Instagram offers you a dedicated trending audio section in its music library. Here’s how you can access it to get the trending sounds:

  1. Open Instagram and go to Reels creation mode by tapping the + icon and selecting Reel.
  2. Select the photo or video you want to include in your Reel, then tap Next in the top-right corner.
  3. Here, tap the Audio button in the horizontal toolbar at the bottom.
  4. Tap the Trending button, and a list of your region’s current trending audios will appear.

3. Use the professional dashboard 

Users with a professional Instagram account do not need to go the extra mile to find trending music. Instagram offers multiple useful tools, including direct access to trending audio, to professional account holders to help them grow on the platform.

Here’s how you can find trending audio on Instagram if you operate a professional account:

  1. Open the Instagram app and head to your profile.
  2. Here, tap on Professional Dashboard.
  3. Next, To add music, select Trending Audio under Tips and Resources, and a list of all the trending music tracks will appear.

4. Follow Instagram’s weekly trend report 

If you are a budding Instagram creator looking to make it big but aren’t following Instagram’s @Creators account, you are missing out on a lot. This account posts tips and tricks for content creation, insights from insiders at Meta, highlights from popular creators, and, most importantly, weekly trend reports, including trending audio.

5. Use Meta Sound Collection 

Meta Sound Collection is a free resource where creators can access a library of music and sound effects for their content. It is especially useful for business accounts that cannot use copyrighted music in Reels.

While this tool doesn’t offer trending audio, it does offer you the option to view and download the most popular audio in particular genres, moods, and vocals. Follow these steps to find trending audio using Meta Sound Collection:

  1. Visit Meta Sound Collection.
  2. Select the Most Popular option in the Sort By filter.
  3. Filter by genre, mood, duration, and more.
  4. Download the track and upload it to your Reel, or search for the same sound within Instagram’s audio library.

6. Follow top Instagram accounts 

The top Instagram accounts in your niche are at the top for a reason. They follow all the trends and post content around them, using trending audio to get more views and engagement. So, consider following popular content creators in your niche who frequently use trending audio.

7. Check trending songs on YouTube Shorts

Most Instagram users cross-post the same content on YouTube Shorts to attract a larger audience. Because of this, sounds that are trending on YouTube Shorts often trend on Instagram as well.

Here’s how you can find the trending music in YouTube Shorts:

  1. Open the YouTube Music app.
  2. Scroll down until you locate the Trending in Shorts section.

  3. Check whether music tracks under the Trending in Shorts section are trending on Instagram.  

8. Use TikTok to predict Instagram trends 

Similar to how the trending audio on YouTube Shorts are often the ones trending on YouTube, the same is true with TikTok. Besides, many Instagram trends often originate from TikTok. So, there’s a good chance that audio trending on TikTok will also be trending on Instagram.

Here’s how you can find them:

  1. Open TikTok and tap the + button to create a new video.
  2. Next, tap on Add Sound at the top of the screen.
  3. Now, browse the Recommended section to see popular audio clips and choose one to add to your video.

Keep your content trending… 

While using trending audio is a great way to boost the visibility of your content on Instagram, it is important to use trending audio that fits your niche and content style. Moreover, the earlier you create content with trending audio, the better your chances of going viral.

Do you have another way to find trending audio on Instagram? Do share it in the comments to help fellow readers.

  • How to send high-quality photos in Instagram DMs on iPhone
  • How to Download Instagram Reel Audio

title.rendered: How to mute Safari tabs on Mac

content.rendered:
You are surfing the web in Safari on your Mac with a bunch of tabs open, and suddenly, you hear a sound from one of the tabs. Pressing the F10 key would be your instinctive move to mute the audio. However, when you do this, it essentially mutes the entire system audio.

This isn’t always desirable, especially if you have some audio playing in other apps on your Mac. What do you do then? Well, you just mute the tab(s) playing the audio. Read on, and I will show you three ways to mute Safari tabs on your Mac.

Mute individual tabs in Safari

When you are browsing a website in Safari and notice an audio playing on your current tab, you can mute (and unmute) it like this:

  1. Locate and click the blue speaker icon in the Safari address bar. It should turn gray when you mute it.

  2. To unmute, click the same icon again, and it will unmute the audio.

Mute other Safari tabs without switching tabs

For times when you want to mute audio playing in a different tab in Safari, you can do it with the following steps without switching the tabs:

  1. Control-click the speaker icon in the address bar and select the Mute Other Tab option from the context menu.

  2. To unmute, Control-click the speaker icon again and select Unmute Other Tab.

Alternatively, you can just click the speaker icon visible on the tab that is emitting the audio to mute and unmute it.

Mute all Safari tabs at the same time

Now, what if there is audio coming from multiple tabs on Safari? You can mute audio from all Safari tabs at once as shown below:

  1. Control-click the speaker icon in the address bar and select Mute Other Tabs.

  2. To unmute, Control-click the icon again and choose Unmute Other Tabs.

How to find out which Safari tabs are playing audio

There are two ways to tell which tabs are playing audio in Safari on your Mac. Let’s take a look.

  • Method 1: Glance through the tabs, and the tabs that are playing audio will display a speaker icon next to their tab names.

  • Method 2: Control-click the speaker icon in the address bar. There, you will see a section called Tabs with Sound, listing all the tabs playing sound.

Signing off

These simple methods to mute (and unmute) audio in Safari are super-efficient. They can particularly be helpful in muting websites that constantly display video ads, which can get pretty annoying and hamper your browsing experience. So, the next time an unnecessary audio from a Safari tab blasts through your speaker, silence it and say not today.

You may find these interesting:

  • How to change the default search engine in Safari
  • How to allow pop-ups in Safari on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
  • How to use Safari Highlights in macOS Sequoia
